baseline_models.mechanism: The scene isolates a repeatable flight cycle: light bodies remain above by alternating aligned extension with contraction, while holding names the continuity preserved through those changes rather than a frozen pose.

activation_trace.role: Literal light flight supplies the moving bodies whose continued elevation needs explanation.
Literal spatial height fixes the vulnerable state that must be continuously maintained.
Literal alignment on an even line renders wing extension as an ordered load-bearing posture.
Literal contraction after extension supplies the alternating phase that keeps the posture dynamic.
Literal holding and preservation name the continuity that spans both phases of motion.

changed_reading.before: A generic picture of birds miraculously kept from falling.
changed_reading.after: A close view of maintained flight in which stability is produced through recurring extension and contraction, and divine holding is continuous across the cycle.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: أولم يروا ... إنه بكل شيء بصير
baseline_models.mechanism: The ayah sends limited human sight into a finite visible scene and closes with comprehensive divine insight over every knowable object; observation is therefore an invitation to reason from a local pattern to the awareness sustaining it.

activation_trace.role: Eye-seeing together with insight makes the opening question an instructed act of observation.
Heart-sight and verified knowledge turn the closing predicate from eyesight into penetrating discernment.
Literal totality makes the scope of the closing sight exhaustive.
The knowable and reportable thing supplies the complete object class encompassed by that sight.

changed_reading.before: A visual wonder followed by a conventional assertion of omniscience.
changed_reading.after: An asymmetric relay between human observation and divine discernment: the viewers are asked to infer from one inspectable event while the holder already sees the whole field.

baseline_models.mechanism: The birds remain grammatical agents of their wing movement while exclusive holding belongs to the Merciful; creature action and divine support operate at different levels and therefore coexist rather than compete.

activation_trace.role: Their own ordered extension supplies active creature participation in the flight.
Their own recurrent contraction prevents holding from being read as creaturely inactivity.
Preserving restraint supplies the enabling action within which the birds continue to act.
Mercy and beneficent care qualify the exclusive holding as support rather than hostile seizure.

changed_reading.before: Divine action replaces or overrides the birds' own action.
changed_reading.after: The birds' exertion is real but nested within merciful preservation; holding enables their agency instead of canceling it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening universal object phrase joins complete capacity to every thing, while 67:3-4 repeatedly returns sight to the Merciful's creation; the focus scene becomes a late, close-range execution of that inspection protocol, with universal sight answering universal capacity.

activation_trace.role: Literal totality begins the surah's exhaustive scope and is repeated in the focus close.
The knowable thing supplies the identical universal object governed by capacity and later by sight.
Effective capacity supplies the opening causal power that the held flight later makes visible.
Repeated eye-and-insight seeing establishes observation as a deliberate test rather than a glance.
Merciful beneficence names the maker of the inspected order and anticipates the holder of the birds.
Literal eyesight is explicitly returned to creation and later answers the focus ayah's opening question.
Returning to a prior view supplies the repeatability of the inspection.
Repetition after a first pass intensifies the demand for sustained empirical attention.
The focus question reopens the established act of eye-and-insight seeing on a nearby moving object.
Penetrating knowledge closes the local inspection by locating it inside comprehensive discernment.

structural_cues: The exact 67:1 phrase كل شيء recurs in 67:19 with capacity replaced by sight.
67:3-4 repeat seeing, returning, and looking before 67:19 again asks whether they see.
الرحمن identifies both the maker of the inspected heavens in 67:3 and the exclusive holder in 67:19.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: universal capacity, repeated inspection, and the same divine name recur around the focus wording. Reader arrow: the bird scene functions as a close-range repeat of the earlier sky test. Alternative: the recurrences may form broad surah cohesion without prescribing one inspection sequence.

changed_reading.before: A self-contained bird example offered for a single glance.
changed_reading.after: A repeatable local test inside the surah's larger program of inspecting creation, where complete power and complete sight converge on the held flight.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate question about a mutually supporting army recodes the birds' aligned formation as a visible rank that cannot support itself; collective order aloft becomes evidence against treating any visible force as an independent protector.

activation_trace.role: A mutually supporting troop supplies the social-military comparison for the birds' visible ranks.
Aid that makes another prevail supplies the protective function denied to any alternative force.
The repeated Merciful identifies the same beneficent source of aerial holding and human protection.
Deception by what gleams but does not hold exposes the error of trusting visible formation as self-supporting power.
An aligned line, including a battle rank, gives the birds a formation that can receive the army comparison.
Actual preservation distinguishes the unseen holder from the merely visible rank.

structural_cues: 67:20 follows the bird scene without a narrative break and asks another أمّن/من-style exclusive-support question.
The alignment branch for صافات explicitly includes martial ranks, while 67:20 supplies جند.
الرحمن is repeated across the two ayat.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: aligned ranks, an adjacent army, aid, deception, and the repeated Merciful are explicit. Reader arrow: the army question retrospectively socializes the bird formation as a counter-image of dependent ranks. Alternative: صافات may remain purely visual and the army question may only continue the logic of exclusive support.

changed_reading.before: The birds are an isolated natural sign of support.
changed_reading.after: Their impressive rank becomes a critique of visible collective power: even an ordered host is itself held and cannot replace the source of protection.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact holding root reappears as withholding provision. Holding is therefore not only an upward counterforce but governance of whether an enabling good continues, linking the birds' sustained access to flight with creatures' sustained access to provision.

activation_trace.role: Allotted giving supplies the good whose continued delivery is placed in question.
Literal holding becomes withholding here, exposing the reversible control of continued provision.
Literal preservation in the focus supplies the positive counterpart: a continuity actively allowed to persist.
Merciful beneficence makes continued holding intelligible as ongoing gift rather than neutral mechanics.

structural_cues: يمسكهن in 67:19 is followed two ayat later by أمسك رزقه in 67:21.
Both verses use exclusive rhetorical questions about who can supply the needed support.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: the same holding root governs birds and potentially withheld provision. Reader arrow: continued altitude and continued sustenance are treated as two instances of maintained access to an enabling good. Alternative: the shared verb may mark only divine control, without equating flight conditions and provision.

changed_reading.before: Holding is a one-scene prevention of physical falling.
changed_reading.after: Holding names governed continuance: every moment of flight, like every arrival of provision, depends on an enabling condition being actively sustained rather than withheld.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next contrast between face-down movement and upright straight movement turns the flight cycle into an embodied model of orientation: alignment is preserved through active correction, so being held enables directed motion rather than static suspension.

activation_trace.role: Falling or being turned onto the face supplies the failed orientation against which aerial stability is reread.
Upright completeness supplies the bodily state maintained by successful orientation.
Straightness and balanced alignment supply the stable heading toward which correction tends.
Gentle direction toward a path supplies the functional move from physical orientation to guided motion.
Even alignment supplies the bird's extended stable attitude.
Contraction after extension supplies active correction rather than motionless balance.
Height makes loss of orientation consequential and keeps the model anchored in the visible bird scene.

structural_cues: 67:22 immediately replaces flight above with two contrasted modes of bodily movement.
صافات and مستقيـم both foreground alignment, while يقبضن supplies recurrent adjustment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: face-down, upright, straight, guided movement follows aligned and contracting flight. Reader arrow: wing alternation is read as active stabilization and then as an embodied analogy for orientation. Alternative: 67:22 may begin an independent moral comparison with no retrospective bird analogy.

changed_reading.before: The birds are held in place despite movement.
changed_reading.after: Their holding permits responsive, directed balance; the scene can model guidance as maintained orientation through correction, not freedom from motion.

context_deltas.mechanism: The creation of sights and inward hearts, followed by the charge of little gratitude, turns the opening 'do they not see?' from a shortage-of-evidence question into an accountability question about using an endowed faculty.

activation_trace.role: Created eyesight supplies the perceptual instrument presupposed by the focus question.
The inward heart supplies the reflective uptake that converts seeing into recognition.
Littleness diagnoses deficient response rather than deficient perceptual equipment.
Recognition of a gift supplies the ethical outcome expected from correctly used sight and reflection.
The opening act of eye-and-insight seeing becomes the concrete exercise of the endowed faculty.
Divine penetrating knowledge forms the asymmetrical counterpart to accountable human perception.

structural_cues: 67:19 opens with human seeing and closes with divine sight; 67:23 then names human sights and hearts as created gifts.
قليلا ما تشكرون supplies an evaluative response immediately after listing the faculties.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: human seeing is solicited, the faculties of sight and heart are given, and gratitude is scarce. Reader arrow: failure to read the birds is treated as misuse of an available gift. Alternative: the ingratitude in 67:23 may concern all gifts generally rather than this observation specifically.

changed_reading.before: The audience may simply have failed to notice enough evidence.
changed_reading.after: The bird scene tests whether an already endowed faculty will become inward recognition and gratitude; the deficit lies in uptake, not visibility.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later pairing of the Merciful with reliance makes the birds' simultaneous exertion and being held an embodied configuration of trust: dependence on the preserving agent coexists with repeated creaturely action.

activation_trace.role: The repeated Merciful carries beneficent preservation from the bird scene into the declaration of trust.
Reliant dependence supplies the human relation that the active-yet-held birds can materially model.
Recurrent contraction preserves visible exertion within the reliance model.
Preserving support supplies the dependable action on which exertion rests.
Mercy identifies the holder as the same trustworthy agent named later.

structural_cues: الرحمن is the exclusive holder in 67:19 and the explicit object of faith and reliance in 67:29.
The birds remain active subjects of يقبضن even while the Merciful alone يمسكهن.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: the birds act while being held, and later speakers rely on the same Merciful. Reader arrow: the physical relation is taken as an embodied analogy for active reliance. Alternative: 67:29 may state reliance without asking readers to map it back onto bird motion.

changed_reading.before: Reliance would mean passively waiting for support.
changed_reading.after: The bird cycle pictures reliance as active dependence: real exertion continues inside, and because of, a preserving relation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing sight-question reverses the focus scene's vertical condition: birds remain accessible above because held, while water can descend beyond access and must be restored as a flowing source. Flight and water become paired cases of life-supporting media whose availability is not self-securing.

activation_trace.role: The alerting 'consider and tell me' construction reopens the focus ayah's demand for perceptual inference.
Literal water supplies the second life-supporting medium whose accessibility is under examination.
Descent into depth supplies the downward loss that reverses the birds' maintained height.
A flowing spring supplies restored, reachable circulation rather than inaccessible depth.
Maintained height supplies the upward pole of the vertical reversal.
A place that holds water or remains stable supplies the cross-domain material bridge between aerial support and retained water.
Beneficent care gives both maintained flight and accessible water their shared life-serving valence.

structural_cues: 67:19 and 67:30 both use a seeing question that demands an inference from an ordinary visible condition.
The focus stresses height and holding; the close stresses downward disappearance and renewed flowing access.
The focus inventory itself gives holding a water-retaining material branch.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: seeing, maintained height, water-holding material, deep descent, and a flowing source are supplied. Reader arrow: airspace and groundwater are paired as vertically governed media of creaturely life. Alternative: the closing water question may parallel dependence only generally, without a material air-water analogy.

changed_reading.before: The bird scene concerns a unique aerial marvel.
changed_reading.after: It becomes one pole of a vertical ecology of dependence: what remains aloft and what remains reachable below both require maintained access to a sustaining medium.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates bodily and kinship branches beneath a divine epithet and an ordinary holding verb. It remains anchored in the contiguous يمسكهن/الرحمن relation and their packet branches, but downstream prose should present it only as a material-relational analogy, never as a replacement translation.

activation_trace.role: A kinship tie that holds people together supplies relational attachment rather than an external mechanical grip.
The womb as a protected generative container supplies an enveloping model for merciful airspace.
Cyclic contraction within that container supplies living motion rather than inert storage.

changed_reading.before: The birds are gripped from outside to stop a fall.
changed_reading.after: Merciful holding can be imagined as an enveloping, life-permitting relation within which vulnerable bodies move, closer to containment and attachment than coercive grasping.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the still-bird branch is proverbial rather than the direct sense of الطير. It remains visually anchored in spread-wing gliding, intermittent contraction, and explicit holding, but downstream prose should label it a resonance of apparent stillness, not claim that the ayah lexically denotes a proverb.

activation_trace.role: The proverbial still bird supplies an image of arrested motion associated with awe.
Extended alignment supplies the visible glide that can appear motionless from below.
Intermittent contraction punctuates the apparent stillness and keeps it dynamically sustained.
Preservation supplies the cause of the paradoxical rest within flight.

changed_reading.before: Flight is perceived mainly as speed and continuous flapping.
changed_reading.after: The spread-wing interval can register as reverent stillness aloft, with contraction revealing that the visible rest is an actively sustained pause.

strongest_changes: The exact all-things frame and repeated sight protocol turn 67:19 from an isolated wonder into a close-range inspection where universal capacity and universal discernment meet.
The adjacent army and provision questions recast holding as exclusive protection and reversible continuance, not merely a force preventing a fall.
The created faculties of 67:23 make failure to see the birds a failure of reflective and grateful uptake rather than lack of visible evidence.
The repeated Merciful and later reliance preserve a two-level agency model: wing action remains real inside sustaining dependence.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah's participle/finite-verb alternation presents stable extension and recurrent contraction together, while its opening human sight and closing divine sight make the mechanics an epistemic event. Nearby ayat then move the same structure through protection, provision, orientation, gratitude, reliance, and finally a vertical water reversal without requiring those readings to collapse into one.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether صافات should carry the adjacent military force of جند or only visual alignment.
How far the prone/upright contrast of 67:22 should be projected back into the birds' physical stabilization.
Whether the water-retention and womb/kinship branches reveal intended material relations or only useful exploratory resonances.
